exOfficio.role: Secretary of the Ministry of the Minister

nominated.note: Term per letter of appointment; Minister may remove without reason (S.3(4)); removed members ineligible for re-appointment (S.3(5))

composition.termLength: As specified in letter of appointment

meetings.frequency: Not specified — Board sets own rules (S.3(10))
meetings.chairperson: Secretary of the Ministry of the Minister

powers: Acquire, hold, manage, sell, and mortgage property (S.5)
Invest moneys subject to Minister's direction (S.8)
Appoint officers and servants, determine remuneration from Fund income (S.9)
Perform all acts necessary to give effect to the Act (S.5)

amendments.summary: Amendment to the National Health Development Fund Act. PDF available at documents.gov.lk. Specific changes not yet analysed.
amendments.details: Endorsed 1984-04-26. PDF available from documents.gov.lk. Full analysis would require detailed comparison of the amendment text with the base Act.

timeline.event: National Health Development Fund Act enacted
timeline.details: Enacted as Act No. 13 of 1981. Established the National Health Development Fund as a body corporate with perpetual succession and a Board of Trustees of 7 members to manage the Fund.
Endorsed 26 April 1984. PDF available at documents.gov.lk. Specific changes not yet determined.

tiers.name: Minister
tiers.relationship: Policy authority: gives directions on investment (S.8), determines remuneration of appointed members (S.4), appoints and removes Board members (S.3)

tiers.name: Board of Trustees
tiers.relationship: Governing body: manages Fund, acquires/disposes property (S.5), appoints staff (S.9), invests moneys (S.8)

tiers.name: Fund Operations
tiers.relationship: Operational: health-care institutions, research, disease prevention, medical equipment/drugs (S.7)

tiers.name: Auditor-General
tiers.relationship: Independent audit: annual audit of Fund accounts (S.10), report tabled in Parliament (S.11)

currentReplacement.national: Ministry of Health — policy oversight; Board of Trustees — Fund governance
currentReplacement.provincial: Not applicable — Fund operates at national level
currentReplacement.regional: Not applicable — Fund disbursements may reach regional health institutions but governance is centralised
